NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1240 PM EDT Sat Oct 31 2026

- Cool but still slightly above normal temperatures again today. 

- Low chance for a isolated light showers late today towards central 
MI. 

- Mild early to middle next week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Strong high pressure centered over the eastern Great Lakes today and 
tonight will sustain light winds and a feed of dry air in the low 
levels across Se Mi. Despite the continued influx of moisture aloft, 
this low level dry air will maintain VFR conditions through the TAF 
period. Intervals of warm air advection aloft have supported a few 
light rain showers/sprinkles. While isolated showers/sprinkles may 
persist through the day, the impacts to aviation will be minimal. 

DTW/D21 Convection...No convection will occur through the TAF period.
